lines.text: The Wind Energy Technology program at Mesalands
Community College offers training to meet the grow-
ing demand for qualified wind energy technicians to
provide maintenance on wind turbines. The Associate
of Applied Science Degree in Wind Energy Technology
at Mesalands Community College provides instruction
in wind turbine technology, turbine placement and
safety mechanical systems, electrical theory, power
generation and distribution, hydraulics, and digital
electronics. Students in these programs will be
prepared for rewarding and profitable careers in this
